title: Donkey Kong 64 3D
description: 3DS Port of Donkey Kong 64 made using rt64-3ds
long_description:
* Real stereoscopic 3D, with auto convergence that keeps close-ups comfortable
* In first person, the crosshair sits at the depth of whatever you're aiming at
* Widescreen 400x240 on the top screen
* The HUD on the touch screen, with every counter of the level kept in view
* 60 fps most of the time on a New 3DS, with an interpolated frame between each two of the game's own
* Camera control on the C-Stick, plus gyro aiming
* Settings on the touch screen, opened with SELECT: remap any button, add up to two buttons of your own on the touch screen
* Built-in community mods you can turn on and off: Tag Anywhere (switch kongs from the touch screen), No coin door, Auto bonuses, Easy beetle, Fixed beavers and two that slow parts of the K. Rool fight, plus an Infinite items option
* French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese translations
* Runs on an Old 3DS / 2DS too, at 15-25 fps (install the CIA there)
preinstall_message: You must provide your own dump of the US version of the game at: sdmc:/3ds/DK64/DK64.z64
